subject.title: feat: expose ClawHub catalog feed lanes

question: Should ClawHub extend its current plugin, skill, and promotions feeds with official, community, and reviewed root lanes, and what durable guarantee should each trust-oriented lane name provide?
rationale: The branch proposes a new public discovery and trust contract that differs from current main; code review cannot decide whether mutable metadata is sufficient for endorsement-style lanes or whether those lanes should exist at all.

options.title: Extend Canonical Feeds
options.body: Rebase and implement approved lanes through the current stored publication model with stable identities and documented policy semantics.

options.title: Keep Existing Lanes
options.body: Retain current main's plugin, skill, and promotions boundaries and close this draft without adding endorsement-style lanes.

options.title: Expose Neutral Metadata
options.body: Avoid official or reviewed feed names and expose non-endorsement catalog metadata that consumers may filter under their own policy.

recommendation.title: Extend Canonical Feeds
recommendation.body: Rebase and implement approved lanes through the current stored publication model with stable identities and documented policy semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent catalog and API history makes this contributor the strongest available routing candidate for the current feed contract and its integration boundary.
